description_en: Check the network connectivity of the JDBC connection string
description_zh: 检查jdbc连接串网络连通性
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb check-jdbc-source-net-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckJDBCSourceNetConnection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance is located
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Either DataSourceId or JdbcConnectionString must be specified as input, otherwise an error will occur. If both parameters are specified, JdbcConnectionString will be used preferentially
parameters.help_zh: DataSourceId和JdbcConnectionString必须指定一项作为输入，否则报错。如果上述2个参数均指定，则优先使用JdbcConnectionString入参
parameters.name: data_source_id

ConnectionMessage.description_en: Return message: Error message returned when the connection fails, otherwise returns an empty string ("")
ConnectionMessage.description_zh: 返回信息：连接不通时返回报错信息，否则返回为""

ConnectionStatus.description_en:
Service status:

Network connected: Success

Network not connected: Failed
ConnectionStatus.description_zh:
服务状态：

网络联通：Success

网络不通：Failed
